task_description: Comprehensive audit, bug fix, and feature enhancement of the AI email outreach agent. Fix critical backend bugs (lambda closure, missing endpoints), add new capabilities (templates, scheduling, A/B testing, contact scoring, webhooks, analytics), enhance frontend with search/filter, pagination, toast notifications, and new management pages.

verification.summary: All 65 backend tests pass after review fixes. Frontend TypeScript compilation and production build both succeed with zero errors. All 7 review issues resolved: logs response shape mismatch, manual contact 422, webhook blocking, encryption key warning, scheduled campaign execution, rate-limit deduplication, and duplicate logs endpoint removal.
